# lunar_beacon_anise — independent oracle output for beacon-augmented lunar DOP

Generated by `gen_lunar_beacon_anise.py` (this directory) on 2026-10-01. Consumed by
`tests/validate_lunar_beacon_anise_visibility_dop.rs`, whose header is the
pre-registration (commit db0eb9ec).

## Inputs

The stated scenario numbers only: user and beacon selenographic sites and heights, the
illustrative constellation's Keplerian elements (`LunarConstellation::illustrative_lcns`
definition: semi-major axis R + 8000 km, e 0.6, i 57.7 deg, argument of periapsis 90 deg,
RAAN = mean anomaly = 360 k / n), the Moon GM 4902.800118 km^3/s^2 and radius 1737.4 km
the engine states, and the 5 deg mask. Near-boundary cases are constructed in the
generator (input construction only); ANISE decides their visibility.
